52e1e68c-e14f-4351-9e3c-20dae332d5d8.name: Disrupt Decorum
rules: Goad all creatures you don't control. (Until your next turn, those creatures attack each combat if able and attack a player other than you if able.)

051b132f-61ae-4187-a886-1c8e19ea0102.name: Radiation
rules: At the beginning of each player's precombat main phase, if that player has one or more rad counters, mill that many cards. For each nonland card milled this way, you lose 1 life and remove one rad counter.
